name: Balloon
summary: Single round shiny balloon with a knot and a curly string; a colour param sets the balloon. Anim bob or float.

params.name: y
params.note: y of the knot; the balloon rises about 480 px above it and the string hangs below

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the balloon is about 300 px wide and 480 px tall

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down; float = slow drift up and sideways

author: krakujs
